Here's the current status while the agents run:

**Completed:**
- `DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORMS` config axis — `packages/shared`
- R2 `RunLogStore` + `WorkspaceOperationLogStore` — `packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/storage/`
- `SidecarClient`, `CfCompanySkillsService`, `CfAgentInstructionsService` — `packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/services/`
- Boot wiring + sidecar mode startup log — `server/src/index.ts`

**Just fixed (critical blocker for all route migrations):**
- `ActorContext` in `server/src/http/types.ts` expanded to the full `BoardActor | AgentActor` discriminated union
- `express-adapter.ts` now populates all actor fields (memberships, isInstanceAdmin, source, etc.)
- `authz.ts` rewritten to accept `AuthzReq` — a structural interface satisfied by both `Express.Request` and `RequestCtx`, so every authz helper call works identically in both Express handlers and `Handler` functions

**In flight:**
- Route group 2 (issues, approvals, costs, activity, dashboard) — re-dispatched with fix
- Route groups 1, 3, 4 — notified of fix, continuing

Once all agents complete I'll do a final commit with everything. The only remaining `// TODO(cloudflare):` items after this round will be multer file uploads (need R2 multipart) and the plugin process model (inherently a sidecar concern).
